verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents personnel task tracking, including reminders for security awareness training and policy acceptance, plus custom fields for Personnel and Tasks. That covers the 'every hire got training' half in part. Periodic user access reviews with revoke decisions are a different, adjacent workflow and do not prove leavers lost access at offboarding. missing for 10: HR-system sync of hires/leavers, documented onboarding/offboarding checklists, offboarding access-revocation verification, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, onboarding and offboarding are compliance events — HR-synced checklists prove every hire got training and every leaver lost access

citations.quote: Set up reminders for personnel to complete assigned tasks including policy acceptance and security awareness training completion
Admins can now create custom fields for both Personnel and Tasks
